Maya: Quick follow-up thread for the KV-cache OOM postmortem. Need owners and short deadlines.

Aj: I can run focused heap snapshots on staging and attach flamegraphs. Will replay 30m.

Sara: I'll add soft-limit knobs and eviction logs. Plan: soft_limit=70, hard_eviction=95 for a short trial.

Leo: I'll own canary rollout and dashboards. Want metric names from Aj.

Priya: I'll add an anomaly detector to tag shards with repeated growth spikes and backfill 60d.

Aj: Staging steps:
./infra/reserve --pool staging-kv --3h --start 1768892000
./tools/replay --from 2026-03-18 --dur 30m --isolate
./kv-profiler --out /tmp/kv.pb --time 25m

OpsBot: reserved staging-kv 1768892000-1768892000+10800. Owner: infra-team. :white_check_mark:

Maya: Owners & due dates: Aj +2bd, Sara +3bd, Leo +4bd, Priya +7bd. Weekly Fri 10am PT check-ins.

Aj: I'll upload profiles to gs://redwood-dev/kv-profiles/1768888888/ after run.

Sara: I'll open a small PR with soft limits and eviction histogram, mark for fast review.

Leo: Dashboard metrics: kv.resident_bytes, kv.evicted_count, kv.frag_ratio, kv.gc_pause_ms. I'll template panels.

Priya: Detector rule drafted: resident growth > baseline + 3*sigma OR frag_ratio jump -> tag. PD if same shard fires 3x/7d.

Maya: Risks: profiling may add latency; keep runs isolated. Frag_ratio noisy -> show 5m median.

Aj: Will pass --isolate flag and tag traces.

Sara: Adding compaction playbook as a follow-up if frag_ratio remains >0.45 after tuning.

Maya: Action list posted. Post one-line status by EOD tomorrow in this thread.

Aj: status: replay queued.

Sara: status: PR draft up.

Leo: status: dashboard skeleton ready.

Priya: status: backfill starting tonight.

Maya: Thanks, closing for now.

Aj: end.
